caption: Raw mode, whole window: a pi suggestion for line 4 (soft-wrapped over 5 rows) opened as GPUI Kit inline-completion ghost rows under the line's LAST visual row; line numbers (5…) move down with it; Accept/Reject overlay in the last ghost row.
Cover mode: pide paints the replacement (pre-wrapped by us into 6 rows, green) over GPUI Kit's ghost rows and tints the old line red; buttons in the extra blank ghost row.
Same suggestion without our cover: GPUI Kit's own ghost text (muted_foreground at 0.5, unwrapped rows) under the line.

What clears it (left to right): shown; Down arrow (GPUI Kit drops it, our overlay follows); Up+End back to the line end (auto re-ask lost a race: overlay without gap); focus to the pi composer (hidden); Esc back to the editor (re-asked, gap back); file changed on disk (re-anchored and re-shown).
Tab = Accept through capture_action(IndentInline): our real edit, nothing inserted from the ghost; Cmd+Z undoes it in one step; Esc (capture_action(Escape)) rejects.
